summary: Iteration 166 testing complete. All 23 backend tests passed (17 new feature tests + 6 Stripe webhook tests). Frontend testing verified instructor cover request flow, member referral section, and referral code pre-fill from URL. Commission CSV endpoint verified via backend tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 166 features verified: (1) Commission CSV export returns proper CSV with headers, Jake Ellis row, and TOTAL row; (2) Instructor cover request flow works - creates cover_requests row, returns already_open on duplicate, 400 on self-accept, cancel works; (3) Member referral programme works - Emma has EMMA-4CEB code, registration with referral_code creates pending referral, conversion hook marks referral as earned and credits referrer; (4) All 6 Stripe webhook tests pass. Frontend: Instructor portal shows COVER button in roster view, clicking triggers prompt and creates cover request with toast confirmation. Member portal shows referral section with code, Copy/Share buttons, and stats. URL ?ref=EMMA-XXXX pre-fills referral code in register form.

commission_csv.details: GET /api/memberships/commission.csv returns text/csv with Content-Disposition attachment, header row, Jake Ellis row, TOTAL row. 401 without auth.

cover_requests.details: POST request-cover creates cover_requests row with status=open, requester_name=Jake Ellis. Second POST returns already_open=true. Non-Jake occ returns 404. Accept own request returns 400. Cancel flips status to cancelled. Ops endpoint lists all requests.

referral_programme.details: Emma has referral_code starting EMMA-. Register with referral_code creates member with referred_by set, generates new referral_code, creates pending referral row with credit_pence=500. Conversion hook on _mark_membership_paid flips referral to earned and increments referrer's promo_credit_pence.

stripe_webhook.details: All 6 tests pass: bad sig 400, missing sig 400, unknown event 200, invoice.paid updates billing, invoice.payment_failed flips past_due, subscription.deleted cancels membership.

frontend_instructor_cover.details: COVER button visible in roster view (data-testid=instructor-request-cover). Clicking opens prompt for reason, POSTs to request-cover, shows toast 'Cover requested — your crew has been pinged', navigates back to classes view.

frontend_member_referral.details: Profile tab shows referral section (data-testid=member-referral) with code EMMA-4CEB, COPY and SHARE buttons, stats (Friends joined, Pending, Credit earned). URL ?ref=EMMA-4CEB pre-fills referral code input in register form.
